question.text: A put option has strike Rs. 18,200 and premium Rs. 300. What is the breakeven point for the buyer?

explanation.text: The Logic: Put BEP = Strike - Premium Step-by-step: 1. X = 18,200, P = 300 2. BEP = 18,200 - 300 = Rs. 17,900 3. At 17,900: Payoff = 18,200 - 17,900 = 300 = Premium. P/L = 0. The Trap: For puts, SUBTRACT premium from strike. For calls, ADD premium to strike. Cross-Exam Context: Below BEP = profit zone for put buyer. Above BEP = loss zone. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Put BEP = X - P = 18,200 - 300 = Rs. 17,900.
